_what: THE INTAKE GATE (PIPELINE_V2 Stage 00b). For every panel or table that supplies a VALUE, the tier it came from. Tiers: 1_publisher_source_data > 2_si_tables > 3_author_repository > 4_pdf_text_table > 5_pixels. Anything at 5_pixels must say WHY 1-4 failed, in a sentence a reviewer can check.
_honesty_note: The tier reconnaissance (Source Data -> SI tables -> repository -> PDF text) was done BEFORE any digitiser was written, in that order, and 01_extract_table3.py reads native PDF text only. But THIS FILE was written after stage 04, not before it. Recorded plainly rather than back-dated.

paper.collision_check: EXECUTED: 54 Experiment_IDs in the live corpus, 0 beginning 'AH'.
paper.lab: Michael J. Mitchell (UPenn); Hamilton AG first author

THE_ENDPOINT.screen: Mean normalized intracellular b-mRNA ACCUMULATION, by sequencing barcoded mRNA recovered from FACS-sorted cells. NOT a transfection readout: the authors sampled deliberately before peak translation and ran Figure 3 to confirm transfection separately. See DECISIONS D-1.
THE_ENDPOINT.validation: NanoLuc organ luminescence (Fig 3b) and EGFP+ cell fraction (Fig 3f/3j) -- both genuine delivery readouts.
excluded_as_not_delivery: hydrodynamic diameter, b-mRNA concentration, entrapment efficiency (Supp Fig 1, Supp Fig 10)
body weight and tumour growth curves (Supp Fig 15, 16)
barcode pool-narrowing enrichment (Fig 1f/1g) -- characterises the BARCODES, in one formulation

tier_1_publisher_source_data.checked_how: The article JATS declares exactly ONE supplementary item, ADMA-38-e14370-s001.pdf, which is source/adma72049-sup-0001-SuppMat.pdf. Wiley published no Source Data workbook of any kind.

tier_2_si_tables.available: FOR FORMULATION ONLY, NOT FOR ANY VALUE

si_tables.3: Formulation details of tested LNP library

tier_2_si_tables.used: Supplementary Table 3 (SI pp. 11-13) -> 01_blocks.csv, 133 formulations. Native PDF TEXT, not an image: page.get_images() on those pages returns only the 295x88 running-header logo. Words are taken WITH COORDINATES and clustered by y, never from the linear text stream, because stream order is a rendering artefact and one mis-ordered span would shift a whole row silently.

tier_3_author_repository.checked_how: provenance/tools/find_repo.py --pmid 41603124 --doi 10.1002/adma.202514370 --author Mitchell: zero candidates, every code-search hit an unrelated project. Zero occurrences of GSE/SRP/PRJNA/SRA/E-MTAB/zenodo/dryad/github/figshare in the article XML or in all 22,296 characters of SI text. Data Availability, verbatim: 'The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.'
tier_3_author_repository.note: Methods name the UMI-tools Python package and an R/renv analysis with a lockfile hash ('3ff0e34b'), but no analysis code is deposited. A sequencing deposit would not have been a delivery value anyway; there is not even that.

tier_4_pdf_text_table.why_not_for_values: every value-bearing panel is a flattened raster. page.get_drawings() over all 29 SI pages returns chemistry-free paths only -- the TOC rule, table rules, and two flow-cytometry gating panels on pp. 25-26. The ARTICLE has no PDF rendition obtainable at all (three routes, all refused; see 00_acquisition.json).

value_panels.quantity: log(1 + mean normalized b-mRNA accumulation), 16 sorted populations x 2 strains
value_panels.attributable: NO. The x axis is labelled 'Barcode number' and carries NO tick labels whatsoever; ~124 unlabelled columns. A numeric colour scale does not rescue unlabelled columns.
value_panels.not_digitised_because: the endpoint is excluded by DECISIONS D-1, so no value was read.

value_panels.attributable: YES -- and this is the panel that makes the screen attributable at all. x = 'Amine or thiol' 1..20 with printed ticks, y = 'Dialkyl maleate' 4/6.2/8/8i/9.2/18. 120 cells x 16 panels x 2 strains = 3,840 values, each mapping to an IL_name via Supp Table 3.
value_panels.note: It covers the 120 nDm members ONLY. The 13 catalogue reagents at Index 121-133 appear nowhere attributable.
value_panels.not_digitised_because: the endpoint is excluded by DECISIONS D-1. Had it been admissible this is a CONTINUOUS colour ramp (white floor, scale ticks at 1/2/3) at a measured 300.0 dpi -- readable, but the second-worst tier in PROTOCOL's ordering, and curation/lib/heatmap.py is built for a discrete LUT.

value_panels.quantity: Total liver and total spleen luminescence (p/s), NanoLuc, 0.1 mg/kg, 6 h, i.v., C57BL/6
value_panels.why_tiers_1_4_failed: no Source Data (tier 1); no SI table carries a luminescence value (tier 2); no repository (tier 3); the figure is a flattened JPEG and no PDF rendition of the article is obtainable (tier 4).
value_panels.attributable: YES -- seven groups named in the panel's own legend, and the LNP index -> lipid name mapping is confirmed 6/6 across three independent loci (main-text sentence, Fig 3a panel headers, Supp Table 3 Index).
value_panels.gate: the panel's own printed '18.1x'. Measured 18.123x, px error 0.01, ratio of ratios 1.0013. The gate caught three real mask defects before it passed; see 07_qc.json P12.
value_panels.resolution: 18.42 px per decade. One pixel is a factor of 1.133. axis.TICK_RESIDUAL_PX = 2.5 px, set for 600 dpi renders, would permit a factor-1.37 error here, which is why the printed statistic is the real gate.
value_panels.emitted: NOTHING -- blocked by structure, not by the value. See DECISIONS D-2.

value_panels.quantity: EGFP+ cells (%) in 4 liver and 5 spleen populations, 0.6 mg/kg, 12 h
value_panels.attributable: YES, same seven groups by legend colour.
value_panels.not_digitised_because: blocked by the SAME structure gap as Fig 3b (DECISIONS D-2). Digitising 63 bar tops to emit at most 2 lipids would not change the decision.

structure_sources.source: Supplementary Figure 2 (SI p.16), measured native dpi 137.5
structure_sources.covers: 3 of 120 members (17D9.2, 18D4, 20D8i), each with the amine, the maleate and the product drawn
structure_sources.external_checks: Supp Figs 4-6, printed ESI m/z with ion labels; Supp Figs 7-9, 1H NMR
structure_sources.outcome: 1 of 120 DETERMINED (18D4, MS-confirmed at a 45.8x discrimination margin). 111 of 120 NOT DETERMINABLE -- their amine or maleate is drawn nowhere in this paper and is defined only in reference 34.

structure_sources.tier: 4_pdf_text_table for the NAME; provenance/reagent_registry.py for the structure
structure_sources.outcome: DOPE, Cholesterol, DSPC, SM-102, DLin-MC3-DMA and ALC-0315 resolve identically in the registry and in the live corpus, 6/6 by FULL InChIKey. C14-PEG2000, DMG-PEG2000 and ALC-0159 are deliberately unpinned: a PEG block length is a distribution.
structure_sources.consequence_for_C10: this paper draws no excipient, so there is nothing of ITS OWN to anchor them against. reference_structures.csv carries them as empty-SMILES rows naming that absence, and the registry-vs-corpus agreement is recorded as a check instead.

digitisers_written: ONE, 04_digitize_fig3b.py, for the one panel whose endpoint is admissible. It emits no corpus row.
